dhaka.evidence: Airport/runway and waterway geometry align; historical haze and small masked patches do not prevent shape comparison. Do not interpret greenness or density quantitatively.

chattogram.evidence: Coast, river and city footprint are visible in both views; historical atmospheric haze is stronger. Approve qualitative shape reading with an explicit color/haze caveat.

khulna.evidence: Shared waterways and city area align; no claim about Sundarbans or coastline from the city-center crop. Colors are not a vegetation classification.

rajshahi.evidence: Padma channel and town-side shapes remain readable despite several historical masked patches. The 98.5 percent valid fraction passes; masked patches are explicitly disclosed.

sylhet.evidence: City/river landmarks and surrounding field shapes align. Different vegetation colors are not treated as land-cover or climate conclusions.

barishal.evidence: River bends and built shapes are visible in both complete crops. Comparison is qualitative; water-level and seasonal factors remain possible.

rangpur.evidence: The historical date is correctly 1995, not 1990. Settlements and field patterns are visible with no major occluding cloud; colors cannot establish vegetation change.

mymensingh.evidence: City and river setting can be compared on the shared native grid; sensor/season differences remain explicit. No river-change causal assertion.

coxs_bazar.evidence: Coast, inlet and town-side features align. Both acquisition dates are January 16; shoreline/tide differences require context and are not quantified.

satkhira.evidence: Town, fields and water bodies are visible. This city-center crop is not labeled mangroves or coastline. Avoid interpreting greener appearance as vegetation gain.

bhola.evidence: Island-side land/water shapes are visible, distinct from Barishal imagery. Tidal/sediment effects remain possible; no climate attribution.

sunamganj.evidence: River and surrounding land/field patterns are visible on both crops. Seasonal water and atmospheric differences are disclosed; no causal land-change claim.
